task.owner: Marker for tasks owned by this extension.
task.taskKey: Stable task identity reused for repeated builds of the same project and its terminal.
config.iXenaUnrealTools.build.mode.descr: auto: use the selected Live Coding connection for a matching running Windows Editor; otherwise use existing UBT tasks when Editor is confirmed closed. ubt: standard UBT. Close Editor for class layout, Build.cs, or Target.cs changes.
config.iXenaUnrealTools.build.mode.enumD: Use Live Coding for a running Editor matching the project and engine; use UBT when Editor is confirmed closed. Reject ambiguous identity.
Always use a standard UBT build without automatically invoking Live Coding.
config.iXenaUnrealTools.dotnetPath.descr: Optional explicit dotnet.exe path. Otherwise inspect DOTNET_HOST_PATH / DOTNET_ROOT and this engine's bundled win-x64 SDK. VS Code path variables are supported.
config.iXenaUnrealTools.openLogAfterStop: Stopping normally sends Ctrl+C and tries to retain the terminal; a log snapshot is still saved. Enable this to also open the UBT log, which may move focus.
Show a separate debug button in the status bar.
Hide status buttons when no supported UE build tasks are found. Run Refresh Build Configurations for details.
config.iXenaUnrealTools.alignment.descri: Status bar alignment. Reload the window after changing this setting.
config.iXenaUnrealTools.priority.descrip: Status bar priority; higher values appear further left. Reload the window after changing this setting.
config.iXenaUnrealTools.explorer.panes.d: Explorer panes in Project.code-workspace settings. Falls back to multiExplorer.panes when unset; hides panes when neither is configured. An explicit [] disables them.
config.iXenaUnrealTools.explorer.showCon: Show Content in the selected project or plugin scope (may be large).
config.iXenaUnrealTools.explorer.showHid: Show hidden files in explorer panes.
config.iXenaUnrealTools.engineRoots.desc: Optional UE5 root directories. Also detects UE tasks, workspace engines, and direct children of uetools.unrealEngineInstallationSearchPath. Switching changes the toolchain, not project association.
config.iXenaUnrealTools.intelliSense.ref: Optionally debounce an independent UHT refresh when saving reflected headers under Source/Plugins. Disabled by default.
config.iXenaUnrealTools.intelliSense.deb: Debounce delay in milliseconds for UHT refresh after saving headers.
config.iXenaUnrealTools.intelliSense.ref: After automatic UHT succeeds, request reanalysis from clangd or the C/C++ extension when available.
config.iXenaUnrealTools.explorerIntegrat: Optional absolute path to Code.exe or Code - Insiders.exe for Windows context menus. Auto-detected when empty; otherwise a file picker is offered. Run Register / Update Windows Context Menu after changing it.
config.iXenaUnrealTools.liveCoding.trans: Choose a connection mode with Initialize Engine Plugin. The extension does not automatically build or install a UE plugin.
Manually install iXenaUnrealBridge from the repository; no MCP service required.
Connect to Epic Unreal MCP with the required toolsets enabled.
config.iXenaUnrealTools.liveCoding.mcpUr: MCP HTTP(S) endpoint. The setup wizard asks for IP, port, and path. Default: http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp. Project/engine identity is still verified.
config.iXenaUnrealTools.liveCoding.timeo: Seconds to wait for the actual UE compilation result. A timeout does not mean UE stopped compiling.
config.iXenaUnrealTools.performance.auto: Automatically open CPU/memory monitoring for a recognizable UnrealEditor debug session when one matching plugin instance is available. Breakpoints pause plugin sampling.
config.iXenaUnrealTools.language.descrip: Dynamic extension UI language. Static command/context-menu titles follow VS Code's display language; use Configure Display Language and reload to change them.
config.iXenaUnrealTools.language.enumDes: Follow VS Code: use Simplified Chinese for Chinese locales and English otherwise.
Use Simplified Chinese for the dynamic interface.
Use English for the extension interface.
